name: Sable Adept
text_md: Sable adepts are wandering scholars who bind minor shadows to their service through quiet, exacting ritual, trading raw power for patience and precision.

class_features.name: Shadow Binding
class_features.text_md: A sable adept can bind a single shadow servant to obey her spoken commands for up to 1 hour per class level.

class_features.name: Eclipse Mastery
class_features.text_md: Once per day, a sable adept can call down a brief eclipse, granting concealment to every ally within 30 feet for 1 round.

description_sections.heading: Adventures
description_sections.text_md: Sable adepts adventure to expand their private catalog of shadow-lore, rarely for gold or glory.

fields.weapon_and_armor_proficiency: A sable adept is proficient with all simple weapons, but not with any armor or shields.
